title: A Leapfrog in the Array
statementMd:
Dima is a beginner programmer. During his working process, he regularly has to repeat the following operation again and again: to remove every second element from the array. One day he has been bored with easy solutions of this problem, and he has come up with the following extravagant algorithm.

Let's consider that initially array contains $*n*$ numbers from $1$ to $*n*$ and the number $*i*$ is located in the cell with the index $2*i* - 1$ (Indices are numbered starting from one) and other cells of the array are empty. Each step Dima selects a non-empty array cell with the maximum index and moves the number written in it to the nearest empty cell to the left of the selected one. The process continues until all $*n*$ numbers will appear in the first $*n*$ cells of the array. For example if $*n* = 4$, the array is changing as follows:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/353e66df2b64f64592e4ec61c819b5ad3856d759.png)

You have to write a program that allows you to determine what number will be in the cell with index $*x*$ ($1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$) after Dima's algorithm finishes.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$), the number of elements in the array and the number of queries for which it is needed to find the answer.

Next $*q*$ lines contain integers $*x*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$), the indices of cells for which it is necessary to output their content after Dima's algorithm finishes.

## Output

For each of $*q*$ queries output one integer number, the value that will appear in the corresponding array cell after Dima's algorithm finishes.

## Note

The first example is shown in the picture.

In the second example the final array is $[1, 12, 2, 8, 3, 11, 4, 9, 5, 13, 6, 10, 7]$.
statementZhMd:
Dima 是一名初学者程序员。在工作过程中，他经常需要反复执行以下操作：从数组中移除每第二个元素。有一天，他厌倦了这个问题的简单解法，于是想出了下面这个别出心裁的算法。

假设初始时数组中包含从 $*1*$ 到 $*n*$ 的 $*n*$ 个数字，其中数字 $*i*$ 位于下标为 $2*i* - 1$ 的单元格中（下标从 1 开始编号），数组的其他单元格均为空。在每一步中，Dima 选择下标最大的非空数组单元格，并将其中的数字移动到该单元格左侧最近的空单元格中。这个过程持续进行，直到所有 $*n*$ 个数字都出现在数组的前 $*n*$ 个单元格中。例如，当 $*n* = 4$ 时，数组的变化如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/353e66df2b64f64592e4ec61c819b5ad3856d759.png)

请编写程序，确定 Dima 的算法结束后，下标为 $*x*$（$1 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$）的单元格中将出现哪个数字。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{18}$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$），分别表示数组中元素的数量，以及需要查询答案的次数。

接下来 $*q*$ 行，每行包含一个整数 $*x*_{*i*$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示需要输出算法结束后其内容的单元格下标。

## 输出格式

对于每次查询，输出一个整数，表示 Dima 的算法结束后对应数组单元格中出现的数字。

## 说明

第一个样例在题目描述中的图片里给出。

在第二个样例中，最终数组为 [1, 12, 2, 8, 3, 11, 4, 9, 5, 13, 6, 10, 7]。
